cover_letter.greeting: Dear Business Banking Deposits & Cash Management Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Business Manager role in Business Banking Product Deposits. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role connects the product roadmap to the P&L and keeps a large team focused on the highest-value work.

At Lenovo I documented business requirements for campaign initiatives, turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation options for cross-functional teams. At JPMorgan I benchmarked past marketing-channel budget allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains, and turned large datasets into executive-level reporting for senior leadership.

Running the book of work, preparing business reviews and following through on decisions with product, technology and finance partners is the kind of operating role I want. I'm organized, Jira is one of the tools I've worked in, and I'm comfortable presenting to senior leaders. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
